target.title: fix: redact config endpoint URL secrets
target.body:
## Summary

- omit URL query and fragment components from every provider endpoint shown by `config show`, in both text and JSON
- preserve the scheme/host/path needed to identify the selected endpoint and retain existing `<redacted>@` userinfo behavior
- apply the same diagnostic rule to the coordinator URL and malformed URL fallback

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/799

## Policy choice

Config display is diagnostic output, not a reusable runtime configuration export. Query and fragment components are therefore omitted unconditionally: this is simpler to audit and avoids guessing which parameter names are secret-bearing. The actual configured runtime URL remains unchanged.

## Verification

- `go test -race ./internal/cli -run 'TestConfigShowRedacts(AllEndpointURLComponents|XCPNg|Proxmox|SchemeLess)|TestRedactedConfigURL' -count=1`
- `go test -race ./...`
- `scripts/check-docs.sh`
- `git diff --check`
- autoreview: first pass found raw endpoint callers outside the helper; all were repaired, final pass clean

## End-to-end proof

The regression renders the production text and JSON config views with every exposed provider endpoint set to a URL containing userinfo, a credential-like query value, and a credential-like fragment. Both outputs retain the safe endpoint path and contain none of the injected credential values.
